title: narcissus pseudonarcissus proles minor
intro: Narcissus pseudonarcissus proles minor, commonly known as the wild daffodil or lesser narcissus, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, with health benefits including its potential to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and possess anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of wild daffodil include its ability to act as a cardiac stimulant, improve digestion, and exhibit sedative effects, making it a useful treatment for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Narcissus pseudonarcissus proles minor include alkaloids such as galantamine, lycorine, and narciclasine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
